name: Population
description: Total enumerated population from the census.
expected_availability_note: Published/derived only where a real series exists; never inherit a parent value.

name: Consumer price inflation
description: Year-on-year headline consumer price inflation rate.

name: USD/KES exchange rate
description: US Dollar to Kenya Shilling reference exchange rate.

name: Central Bank Rate
description: The lowest rate of interest the Central Bank of Kenya charges on loans to banks, set by the Monetary Policy Committee.

name: 91-day Treasury bill rate
description: Weighted average yield on the 91-day Treasury bill from the most recent CBK auction.

name: Registered voters
description: Total registered voters on the certified electoral register.
expected_availability_note: Cross-listed in Representation below county.

name: Land area
description: Land area. County and national values use the official KNBS 2019 census land-area table; constituency and ward values are explicitly boundary-derived estimates.

name: Super Petrol pump price
description: Maximum retail price of Super Petrol, as set monthly by EPRA.

name: Statistical Performance Indicators — Overall score
description: World Bank Statistical Performance Indicators overall score for Kenya's statistical system.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.
composite_disclosure: Compiled index; not a raw statistic.

name: Access to electricity (% of population)
description: Share of Kenya's population with access to electricity, harmonised by the World Bank for international comparability.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: GDP (current US$)
description: Kenya gross domestic product in current US dollars, harmonised by the World Bank.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: GDP per capita (current US$)
description: Kenya GDP per person in current US dollars, harmonised by the World Bank.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: GDP growth (annual %)
description: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Life expectancy at birth
description: Life expectancy at birth in years, harmonised by the World Bank.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Population, total — UN projection via World Bank
description: National population estimate/projection published by the World Bank using UN Population Division data; not a census enumeration.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Population growth (annual %)
description: Annual population growth rate based on the World Bank/UN harmonised population series.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Net migration
description: Net number of migrants over the reference period from the harmonised World Bank series.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Human Capital Index (overall)
description: World Bank composite Human Capital Index. This is a compiled index, not a raw statistic.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.
composite_disclosure: Compiled/modelled index; not a raw statistic.

name: Poverty headcount ratio at $3.00/day (2021 PPP)
description: Share of the population below the World Bank $3.00/day international poverty line in 2021 PPP terms. Not interchangeable with Kenya's domestic poverty line.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Unemployment, total (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Modeled ILO estimate of unemployment as a share of the total labour force, published through World Bank WDI.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
description: Annual World Bank harmonised consumer price inflation. The Atlas's monthly KNBS series remains the headline inflation series.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Personal remittances received (% of GDP)
description: Personal remittances received as a share of GDP. Kept sourced-only while a CBK-primary-source treatment is designed.
expected_availability_note: CBK publishes the underlying monthly remittance inflows directly; do not finalize a secondary-source headline before primary-source derivation is designed.

name: Forest area (% of land area)
description: Forest area as a percentage of land area, harmonised by the World Bank.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: CO2 emissions per capita (excl. LULUCF)
description: Carbon dioxide emissions per person excluding land-use, land-use change and forestry, harmonised by the World Bank.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Freshwater withdrawals (% of internal resources)
description: Annual freshwater withdrawals as a share of total internal renewable water resources; distinct from household water access.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Renewable electricity share, excluding hydro
description: Share of electricity output from renewable sources excluding hydroelectric power.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Safely managed sanitation services (% of population)
description: Share of the population using safely managed sanitation services.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
description: Share of individuals using the Internet, published through World Bank WDI. Link to a Communications Authority series only after a CA series is actually ingested.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Intentional homicides (per 100,000 people)
description: Intentional homicides per 100,000 people, harmonised for international comparability.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Seats held by women in national parliament (%)
description: Share of seats in the national parliament held by women.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
description: Foreign direct investment net inflows as a share of GDP.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: GINI index
description: GINI index from the World Bank WDI series; reference year is always displayed because the series can be stale or irregular.
expected_availability_note: National-only WDI series; never inherit to a subnational geography.

name: Overall poverty headcount rate
description: Share of individuals below Kenya’s overall poverty line in the 2022 Kenya Poverty Report.
expected_availability_note: County survey estimate; sampling uncertainty required when activated.

name: Children under 5 stunted
description: Share of children under age 5 whose height-for-age is below minus two standard deviations from the WHO Child Growth Standards median.
expected_availability_note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

name: Children 12–23 months fully vaccinated with basic antigens
description: Share of children age 12–23 months who received all basic antigens as defined in KDHS 2022 Table 10.4C.
expected_availability_note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

name: Skilled birth attendance
description: Share of live births in the two years before KDHS 2022 assisted by a skilled provider (doctor, nurse, midwife or clinical officer).
expected_availability_note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

name: Health facilities assessed in the 2023 Health Facility Census
description: Count of health facilities assessed in each county in the 2023 Ministry of Health Health Facility Census.
expected_availability_note: Official registry; profile count is derived from registered facility records.

name: Public primary schools
description: Count of public primary school establishments in the TSC 2023 county table.

name: Primary classroom teachers
description: TSC 2023 classroom-teacher establishment in public primary schools.

name: Public secondary schools
description: Count of public secondary school establishments in the TSC 2023 county table.

name: Secondary teachers
description: TSC 2023 teacher establishment in public secondary schools.

name: Agriculture gross value added
description: Agriculture, forestry and fishing gross value added at current prices in 2024.

name: Manufacturing gross value added
description: Manufacturing gross value added at current prices in 2024.

name: Agriculture share of GCP
description: Agriculture, forestry and fishing gross value added as a share of 2024 Gross County Product.

name: Manufacturing share of GCP
description: Manufacturing gross value added as a share of 2024 Gross County Product.

name: Maize area
description: Area under maize reported for 2023.

name: Maize production
description: Maize production reported for 2023.

name: Maize yield
description: Tonnes of maize production per reported hectare in 2023, calculated by the Atlas from the two fields in the same official county row.

name: Individuals using internet
description: Share of individuals aged 3 years and above who used the internet in the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey.

name: Individuals using a computer
description: Share of individuals aged 3 years and above who used a computer in the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey.

name: Households connected to main-grid electricity
description: Share of households connected to electricity on the main grid in the 2023/24 Kenya Housing Survey.

name: Gross County Product (current prices)
description: Gross County Product at current prices. 2024 is preliminary.

name: County budget
description: Total county budget for the fiscal year.

name: County expenditure
description: Total county government expenditure for the fiscal year.

name: County budget absorption rate
description: Total expenditure as a percentage of the county budget.

name: Development budget absorption rate
description: Development expenditure as a percentage of the development budget.

name: USD/KES monthly period-average exchange rate
description: Monthly period-average Kenya shillings per US dollar published by CBK.

name: 91-day Treasury bill monthly average rate
description: Monthly average 91-day Treasury bill rate published by CBK.

name: Population, 2009 census
description: County population from the 2009 census, surfaced as its own fixed profile slot.
expected_availability_note: County only; generated from the already-ingested 2009 population observations.

name: Average household size
description: Average number of persons per household.
expected_availability_note: Constituency alignment must be verified before activation.

name: Literacy rate
description: Share of the relevant population meeting the published literacy definition.
expected_availability_note: County only until a valid lower-level tabulation is confirmed.

name: Dwelling wall/roof material (% permanent)
description: Share of dwellings classified as permanent by the published census material definition.
expected_availability_note: County only.

name: Disability prevalence (Washington Group short set)
description: Prevalence using the Washington Group short-set disability identification questions.
expected_availability_note: County census indicator.

name: Inua Jamii cash-transfer beneficiaries
description: Beneficiaries of Older Persons, OVC, Persons with Severe Disability and HSNP schemes.
expected_availability_note: No citable per-county publication identified; must not be promoted to sourced without one.

name: Mean KCPE / KCSE score
description: County-level mean examination performance, only if a genuine KNEC primary table is located.
expected_availability_note: Do not source from blogs/news aggregations; retire if no primary county table exists.

name: Licensed businesses (count, year-on-year change)
description: Licensed business count and year-on-year change where a county publishes a usable series.
expected_availability_note: Coverage is inconsistent; ingest opportunistically and never manufacture missing counties.

name: Key crop production (county-dominant crop only)
description: Production of the county-dominant crop where a comparable official table exists.
expected_source: KNBS Economic Survey / Ministry of Agriculture
expected_availability_note: Crop and unit vary; requires indicator-specific ingestion before activation.

name: HIV prevalence
description: Published HIV prevalence estimate.
expected_availability_note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

name: Facilities with electricity/water (%)
description: Share of facilities with electricity/water in the Kenya Health Facility Census snapshot.
expected_availability_note: One-off snapshot; label prominently as a snapshot if activated.

name: Teenage pregnancy rate, age 15–19
description: Published teenage pregnancy rate among ages 15–19.
expected_availability_note: Sample survey; plain statistic only, no worst-county ranking.

name: Home births (vs. facility births)
description: Share of births occurring at home.
expected_availability_note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

name: Modern contraceptive use rate
description: Published modern contraceptive use rate.
expected_availability_note: Sample survey; confidence interval/SE/sample size required when active.

name: FGM prevalence / child marriage rate
description: Published prevalence measure, presented neutrally without editorial ranking.
expected_availability_note: Sample survey; never render as a shame/worst-offender ranking.

name: Drug and substance use prevalence
description: Published prevalence from the NACADA national survey, subject to verification of county coverage.
expected_source: NACADA National Survey on the Status of Drugs and Substance Use in Kenya 2022
expected_availability_note: Do not activate until the newest round's county coverage is verified; sampling uncertainty is mandatory.

name: Hospital bed occupancy/utilisation rate
description: Hospital bed utilisation if a public Kenyan source is identified.
expected_availability_note: No confirmed public Kenyan feed; remain planned until a citable source exists.

name: Food security phase classification (IPC-style)
description: Acute food insecurity phase classification from seasonal assessments.
expected_source: National Drought Management Authority (NDMA) seasonal food security assessment
expected_availability_note: County conditional; NDMA assessment coverage is institutional, not a temporary data gap.

name: Drought early warning bulletin status
description: Monthly drought early warning status from NDMA bulletins.
expected_source: NDMA monthly drought early warning bulletins
expected_availability_note: Machine-readable table structure not yet reviewed.

name: Rainfall and temperature (historical series)
description: Historical rainfall and temperature where an official open-data channel exists.
expected_availability_note: Remain planned unless a genuine historical-data channel is confirmed.

name: Own-source revenue vs. target
description: County own-source revenue performance against target.
expected_source: Office of the Controller of Budget County Budget Implementation Review Report FY2024/25
expected_availability_note: Same trusted report family as budget/expenditure; first-priority sourced promotion.

name: Pending bills
description: County pending bills reported by the Controller of Budget.
expected_source: Office of the Controller of Budget County Budget Implementation Review Report FY2024/25
expected_availability_note: Same trusted report family as budget/expenditure; first-priority sourced promotion.

name: Auditor-General opinion
description: County audit opinion: unqualified, qualified, adverse or disclaimer.
expected_source: Office of the Auditor-General Summary Report on County Governments 2024/2025
expected_availability_note: Categorical audit opinion; do not turn into an unsupported composite score.

name: Member of Parliament (name, party)
description: Current constituency Member of Parliament identity and party, once a checkable source is curated.
expected_availability_note: No single confirmed machine-readable source; remain planned.

name: Member of County Assembly (name, party)
description: Current ward MCA identity and party, once a checkable source is curated.
expected_availability_note: No single confirmed machine-readable source; remain planned.

name: NG-CDF allocation (financial year)
description: Constituency NG-CDF allocation for the financial year.
expected_availability_note: Do not promote until a specific citable report/page is identified.

name: NG-CDF utilization rate
description: Constituency NG-CDF utilization rate.
expected_availability_note: Do not promote until a specific citable report/page is identified.

name: Ward-level development fund allocation
description: Ward-level development fund allocation where separately and officially reported.
expected_availability_note: Never divide county budgets mechanically by ward count.

name: Turnout, prior general elections
description: Voter turnout in prior general elections.
expected_availability_note: Natural extension of the Sprint 2 electoral architecture; not yet ingested.

name: Households with electricity (%)
description: Share of households whose main lighting source indicates electricity access.
expected_availability_note: County census indicator.

name: Classified road length (km)
description: Length of classified road network.
expected_availability_note: No single clean county table identified.

name: Households with access to improved water source (%)
short_name: Households with access to improved water source (%)
description: Share of households with access to an improved water source.
expected_availability_note: Utility service areas do not align cleanly with counties; crosswalk required before promotion.

name: Health facilities per 10,000 population
description: Atlas-derived facility density from KMHFR geocoded facilities and canonical geography polygons.
expected_availability_note: When activated, badge B: transparent aggregation of official facility points; never presented as a KMHFR-published area table.

name: Registered vehicles (count, per capita)
description: Registered vehicles by county if a public county breakdown is confirmed.
expected_availability_note: Public county breakdown not confirmed; remain planned.

name: Mobile money transaction volume
description: National mobile-money transaction volume for the Kenya Pulse.
expected_source: Central Bank of Kenya / Communications Authority
expected_availability_note: National-only Pulse slot; no county breakdown identified.

name: Rent as a share of household expenditure
description: Rent as a percentage of household expenditure by county, using the published total column.
expected_availability_note: Rent-burden measure only; not a synthetic cost-of-living index or prediction of an individual household rent.

name: Households owning their main dwelling
description: Percentage of households that own their main dwelling unit.
expected_availability_note: Tenure status is not itself a measure of housing quality, affordability or household wealth.

name: Health facility count
description: Facilities targeted by the Kenya Health Facility Census from the KMHFL list as at 1 August 2023.
expected_availability_note: Facility-stock/supply context only; does not measure travel time, service quality, capacity or personal access.

name: Population age 3+ at school or learning institution
description: Percentage of population age 3 years and above recorded as at school or a learning institution.
expected_availability_note: Attendance status, not learning quality or attainment. County age structure affects comparisons.

name: Labour-force participation rate, age 15–64
description: Total labour-force participation rate for population age 15–64 years.
expected_availability_note: Labour-force participation is not unemployment, job quality, earnings or probability of finding work.
